rule_or_requirement: The exact pixel-only candidate must cross the qualified finish line at least as often as the selected control; compare finished lap time only after completion ties. Grass contact alone is diagnostic.
observable_information: Frozen ZIP bytes, grayscale frame stacks, valid actions, qualified finish events, lap times, collisions, damage, and runtime measurements.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Execute unchanged extracted ZIP agents on the same held-out tracks and seeds; candidate steers earlier from pixels and increases gas on visible stable road.
expected_success_endpoint: At least as many qualified finish crossings as selected full-road-guard across twelve cells; shorter median finished lap if completion ties.
falsifier: Fewer candidate finishes, invalid action, ZIP/runtime limit breach, or equal finish count without shorter median finished lap; road contact is reported but is not an automatic veto.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Twenty-four episodes: both immutable ZIPs on tracks 1–3 crossed with held-out seeds 2004–2007, at most 2,000 decisions per episode.
resource_and_risk_gate: Registered Linux CPU profile, at most 2 CPUs, 2 GiB, 1,800 seconds; no parameter adjustment, website upload, official submission, or model confirmation.
